name: Onions
description: Onions are a versatile vegetable known for their high content of phytonutrients, particularly flavonoids and sulfur compounds. Beyond adding depth of flavor to culinary dishes, they possess significant anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that support metabolic health.

macroNutrients.name: Calories
macroNutrients.description: A low-calorie food rich in fiber and biologically active compounds.

macroNutrients.name: Protein
macroNutrients.description: Contains a small amount of plant-based protein.

macroNutrients.name: Carbohydrates
macroNutrients.description: Contains natural sugars and prebiotic dietary fibers that are beneficial for gut microflora.

microNutrients.name: Quercetin
microNutrients.description: A potent flavonoid antioxidant that helps fight inflammation and supports heart health.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin C
microNutrients.description: Supports immune function and helps protect cells from oxidative damage.

microNutrients.name: Fiber
microNutrients.description: Provides prebiotic fibers like inulin to feed beneficial gut bacteria.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin B6
microNutrients.description: Plays an important role in metabolism and red blood cell production.

microNutrients.name: Potassium
microNutrients.description: Helps maintain fluid balance and supports healthy blood pressure levels.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin B9
microNutrients.description: Essential for proper cell division, DNA synthesis, and tissue growth.

microNutrients.name: Manganese
microNutrients.description: Supports bone formation, metabolism, and enzyme function.

healthBenefits: Heart Health: Regular consumption helps improve blood circulation and maintain healthy cholesterol levels.
Antioxidant Support: A high concentration of quercetin helps neutralize free radicals.
Microbiome Support: The prebiotic fibers in onions serve as food for beneficial gut bacteria.
Anti-inflammatory Effects: Sulfur compounds assist in reducing inflammatory markers in the body.
precautions: Digestive Sensitivity: In some individuals, raw onions may cause bloating or heartburn.
Eye Irritation: Cutting onions releases volatile substances that can irritate the eyes.
Individual Intolerance: Allergic reactions to components of the plant are possible.
